title: 1987 Topps #779 Craig Reynolds Houston Astros Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1987 Topps baseball trading card of Craig Reynolds, a player for the MLB team Houston Astros. The card is in English and part of a set of Isolated Cards. It is card number 779 and not autographed. The card was manufactured by Topps in the United States.
